name: ai-cost-coach
description: See where your AI spend goes, from a month down to a single tool call, for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot Chat.

commands.title: AI Cost: Set Up Copilot Tracking

aiCost.openOverviewOnSelect.description: Open the full overview in an editor tab when you select the AI Cost icon.

aiCost.maxSessions.description: How many recent session transcripts to read. Sessions with no prompts are not listed.

aiCost.copilotDays.description: How many days of Copilot CLI and VS Code chat history to load.

aiCost.sources.description: Which tools to load sessions from.

aiCost.refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-read the session logs.

aiCost.notifyHeldPrompts.description: Show prompts that strict mode holds in VS Code chat as notifications, with Why, Send anyway and Copy prompt. Off, VS Code chat gets a tip instead of a block, because VS Code shows nothing for a stopped prompt.

walkthroughs.title: Get to know AI Cost Coach
walkthroughs.description: See where your AI spend goes, from a month down to a single tool call.

steps.title: See where the money goes
steps.description:
The overview opens in a tab when you select the AI Cost icon: cost by month, split by tool (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, VS Code chat), with tiles, tokens, models and the most expensive prompts.
[Open the overview](command:aiCost.overview)

media.altText: The overview: cost by month, split by tool

steps.title: Change the range, or leave a tool out
steps.description: Pick **By day**, 7d, 30d or 90d. Click a tool in the legend under the chart to leave it out and click again to bring it back. The tiles, the lists, the Sessions tree and Advice all follow.

media.altText: By day, with Copilot CLI left out through the legend

steps.title: Keep it in the sidebar
steps.description: The AI Cost icon in the activity bar shows a compact overview, the Sessions tree, Advice and the Coach panel. Sort, filter and sync from the title bar.

media.altText: The compact overview in the sidebar

steps.title: Open a month
steps.description: Click a month, in the chart or the table, to see its days. A breadcrumb takes you back, and you can filter the Sessions tree to that month.

steps.title: Open a session
steps.description: Click a session, in the tree or on a bar. You get its cost per prompt, where its tokens went, its models, and every prompt with tokens in and out, cache hit and cost.

media.altText: A session: cost per prompt, tokens, models and prompts

steps.title: Open a prompt
steps.description: A prompt shows the cost of each model call, the tools each call used, and every tool call it made. A breadcrumb and a Back button run along the top of every detail panel.

media.altText: A prompt: its model calls and tool calls

steps.title: Open a model call
steps.description: See what went in (what was new since the previous call) and what came out: the reply, the reasoning where it is recorded, and each tool request.

media.altText: One model call: what went in and what came out

steps.title: Open a tool call
steps.description: Click any tool to see its full input and its result, with its status, size and time. It works for Claude Code and Copilot CLI.

media.altText: One tool call: its input and its result

steps.title: Cost tips, strict mode and the cost gate
steps.description:
Turn on Copilot tracking to get cost tips, strict mode and per-call tokens for Copilot sessions. Strict mode holds a prompt that would restart a big cold cache, with its price, and a prompt you already ran. The Coach panel shows what it held and what you did next.
[Set up Copilot tracking](command:aiCost.enableCopilotTracking)
[Coach results](command:aiCost.coachResults)

media.altText: Coach results: what was held, what you did next
